kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
أتأرجح (form IIq)
# أَتَأَرْجَحُ (ʔataʔarjaḥu) /ʔa.ta.ʔar.d͡ʒa.ħu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of تَأَرْجَحَ (taʔarjaḥa)
# أَتَأَرْجَحَ (ʔataʔarjaḥa) /ʔa.ta.ʔar.d͡ʒa.ħa/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of تَأَرْجَحَ (taʔarjaḥa)
# أَتَأَرْجَحْ (ʔataʔarjaḥ) /ʔa.ta.ʔar.d͡ʒaħ/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of تَأَرْجَحَ (taʔarjaḥa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
